# Contributing to wd-broker

Thank you for your interest in contributing to wd-broker! Contributions and feedback of any kind are welcome and highly appreciated.

## How to Contribute

### Reporting Issues

Please use the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/fjulian79/wd-broker/issues) page to report bugs or request new features. When reporting an issue, please:
- Include a clear and descriptive title.
- Provide detailed information and context.
- Mention the steps needed to reproduce the issue if it's a bug.

### Pull Requests

If you wish to contribute code:

1. Fork the repository and create a new branch for your changes.
2. Ensure your changes follow the coding style of the project (consistent indentation, clear naming).
3. Write concise and meaningful commit messages.
4. Make sure your code compiles without warnings or errors and that existing tests pass.
5. Submit your Pull Request, clearly describing your changes and referencing any relevant issues.

I will review your Pull Request as soon as possible and may ask you for further adjustments or clarifications.

## Coding Style and Guidelines

- Keep code simple and readable.
- Follow existing code structure and naming conventions.
- Write clear comments and documentation for new features.
- Use the project's provided clang-format configuration (.clang-format) to automatically format your code.

## Questions and Support

If you have questions or need help, open an issue clearly labeled as a question, or directly mention me (@fjulian79) in an issue or pull request.

Thank you again for your support and contributions!
